title: Built a prelaunch game platform to help developers build community and validate game idea before release.
author: varunkumarnr
selftext:
**Working on PixelPicked** a curated pre-launch OS for mobile games. and How AI was used to improve devleoper expierence and make Lifecycle easier. 

The idea is simple: support developers from their first prototype all the way to launch day.

It includes:

* Curated game pages
* Devlogs and other community building tools
* Build Wishlists notify everyone on launch
* Auto analytics - session, retention, FPS, crashes, funnel tracking , heatmaps. No SDK, no code setup needed.
* dynamic Feedback collection
* A/B testing support
* Weekly launch campaign events
* and other featues

**AI used:** We built an analysis framework that currently supports Unreal Engine, Unity, and Godot.

After a parser extracts gameplay events, AI is used to identify and correlate related events, discard irrelevant ones, shortlist meaningful events for developer review, and automatically inject analytics listener scripts.

We never send `.pck` files or any other game assets to the AI. Only the extracted event data is processed. Surprisingly, this approach works very well. The framework is currently running analysis on 20 game builds.  Also helps in reccemdation of improvements after looking at the analytical data.  

PixelPicked is also a curated platform that launched 5 days ago. So far, we've accepted **50 games** out of **80 submissions(30 dint make the cut)**. We also use AI to generate an initial quality score for each game's public page. No personally identifiable information (PII) is processed. The AI simply analyzes the public game page and returns a score that assists our curation process , later human makes the final desicion 

The platform is completly free no freemium features too. If this sounds intresting please check us out love to hear feedback. [https://pixelpicked.com/](https://pixelpicked.com/) 

Also what other steps has AI helped you in dev lifecycle, except obvious, in code or assets generation.
